prompt: How many times has the Turing Award been given to multiple winners in the same year?
answer:
As of the 2025 award, the Turing Award has been given to multiple winners in the same year **18 times**.

The ACM’s 2024 figures listed **17 such years**—14 with two recipients and 3 with three. The 2025 award to Charles H. Bennett and Gilles Brassard added one more.
